operation.source_intent: Search the selected site's WordPress users with a role filter, reset to first page, re-read WordPress REST on each search.

laravel_runtime.semantics: The authorized /sites/{site}/users server route redirects after ownership check to /module/users?site={site}. The frontend verifies selected site query against server-issued tenant/site users API, binds the specific UsersManager search operation, supports an allowlisted role filter, trims the keyword, resets page one and re-fetches even when filters are unchanged. The server checks sites.view, tenant-scoped site ownership and performs native WordPress users REST GET with role and search. Remote API denial remains a visible failure.
laravel_runtime.loading_error_empty_behavior: Search disabled while WordPress users are fetching. Empty, denied and transient remote results are surfaced as they are; no fake success.
